image_generation_policy: use frozen 42 V9 and 18 V10 API results; missing files fail
input_fusion: 79 camera-derived BEV observations with frozen historical building-exclusion masks
height_policy: frozen predicted world Z with historical GT-derived support; no current-building recomputation
road_topology_policy: GT reference included in data/smallcity_p384_gt_roads; not predicted road extraction
reference_mesh_policy: cached Pixal3D background, GT height fallback used, not regenerated by this command
water_restoration_policy: reuse frozen historical exterior-water treatment; preserve recomputed V9 outside mask
runtime: CPU, disk-backed rasters, local cc/libpng helper; no network
temporary_output_policy: Use runs/ for validation; remove duplicate reruns after checks; retain published inputs and formal results
